title: Real codebase: add a new subcommand to a real multi-file CLI, following its existing conventions
taskPrompt: There is a real Node.js CLI tool in the current directory: assay/route.mjs (which uses assay/classify.js), with existing 'check' and 'ask' subcommands, plus a claims/ directory of *.claim.json fixture files (each has a "claim_id" string field and an "expect" field that is either "pass" or "refute"). Add a NEW subcommand: `node assay/route.mjs list` must read every *.claim.json file in claims/, and print exactly one line per claim to stdout in the form `<claim_id> <expect>` (the two values separated by a single space, nothing else on the line), sorted alphabetically by claim_id, then exit with code 0. Do not change the existing 'check' or 'ask' behavior — they must keep working exactly as before. Use edit_file, not write_file, on assay/route.mjs — it is a real existing file, not something to retype from scratch. Actually run `node assay/route.mjs list` and compare a few lines against the real files in claims/ before calling finish.
